pages.text: The number π: 3.141592653589793.$(br2)PI is a constant, not a function, so you don't CALL it. After $(1)INCLUDE c0de/math$(), use its full name $(1)c0de/math/PI$() in an expression, like a variable. It is a FLOAT.
SIN, COS and TAN take angles in radians: a full circle is 2 × PI, a right angle PI / 2. To turn degrees into radians, multiply by PI / 180.
